changeSet.author: pconrad
changeSet.comment: Widens JOB_LOGS.MESSAGE (declared VARCHAR(1048576) by the lib-jobs library's own bundled changeset) to TEXT before the INSERT below copies data into it -- production has at least one job log longer than 1,048,576 characters (see docs/liquibase.md incident writeup), and the INSERT would otherwise fail the same way changeset 010's UPDATE originally did. Postgres-only: on H2 (used by tests and the local/CI development profile), the JobLog entity's @Column(columnDefinition="TEXT") is validated by Hibernate as expecting a VARCHAR-category column, and widening to a literal TEXT column here makes H2 report it as CLOB instead, failing the CI schema-validation check -- H2 test/dev data never approaches the real production length problem anyway, so MESSAGE is left at its library-declared VARCHAR(1048576) there.

changeSet.author: pconrad
changeSet.comment: lib-jobs v0.2.0 backfill (2/2): move the staged log text into JOB_LOGS, one row per job (per-line timestamps were never preserved by the old single-column design, so a historical job's full log becomes a single JOB_LOGS row), then drop the staging column. Runs after the lib-jobs library changelog has created JOB_LOGS and dropped JOBS.LOG -- included separately in changelog-master.json rather than swept up by includeAll, since it must run after that library include, not before it like every other app-owned changeset.

sql.sql: INSERT INTO JOB_LOGS (JOB_ID, MESSAGE, CREATED_AT) SELECT ID, LOG_BACKFILL, COALESCE(UPDATED_AT, CREATED_AT) FROM JOBS WHERE LOG_BACKFILL IS NOT NULL AND LOG_BACKFILL <> ''
